newsitem.title: UK: Zeneca gains on U.S. approval for fungicide.
newsitem.headline: Zeneca gains on U.S. approval for fungicide.

text.p: Shares in Zeneca Group Plc rose on Monday as the drug and agrochemical company said its fungicide azoxystrobin had gained its first U.S. registration.
The stock was up 16p at 17.46-1/2 by 1239 GMT.
Zeneca said the U.S. Environment Protection Agency had approved the use on turfgrass of the product, to be marketed as Heritage, and which is designed to control several significant diseases.
It will be launched later this month in a world market Zeneca estimates to be worth three billion stg.
Jo Walton, analyst at Lehman Brothers, said the announcement was a major event in fungicides which had seen no significant new developments for some time.
"This is a major approval for Zeneca," Walton said, "it is aimed at a $5 billion market and they hope to gain ten percent of that market."
